tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, REST/OCC APIs, micro-services, and data integration between PIM, ERP and MDM. Proven record in CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, production support, and techno-functional analysis of business requirements, user stories and process mapping.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

keywords_missing: SAP Commerce Cloud storefront extensions using Angular

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer
cover_en.hook: I am excited about Entrans’ commitment to cutting-edge e-commerce platforms. With 5+ years building and scaling SAP Commerce Cloud solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise that matches your needs.

bullets.label: Design & Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) features—product catalog, pricing and customer data—using Java, Spring and OCC REST services.

bullets.label: API & Integration
bullets.text: Built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines (Profisee, Hotfolders, DataHub) and migrated customer account APIs, ensuring seamless integration with ERP and MDM systems.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Worked directly with business stakeholders to analyse requirements, write user stories and functional specs, translating them into robust SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Production & DevOps
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2), leveraged Docker/Kubernetes and resolved production issues to maintain high availability.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, holding a valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026 and available to start 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Entrans.

tailoring.why_company: Entrans’ focus on innovative, scalable e-commerce solutions and its strategic use of SAP Commerce Cloud align perfectly with my experience delivering high-performance SAP Commerce platforms for global brands. I am eager to help Entrans accelerate its digital commerce roadmap and drive measurable business value.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to help Entrans deliver innovative, high-performance e-commerce solutions that drive growth.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m interested in the SAP Commerce Cloud role at Entrans and would love to discuss how I can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP Commerce Cloud Developer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Commerce Cloud Developer position. With over five years of hands-on experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can contribute to Entrans’ success.

Thank you for your consideration.
